text:
Jules: hey team, first oncall day and i'm blocked on two things: i can't ack test alerts in PagerDuty (button is greyed out) and the night runbook link throws a JSON parse error in the UI. filed access form earlier but wanted quick help.
Priyanka: welcome Jules! for PD, are you in the "eng-oncall" PD team? sometimes invites don't finish. Marco, can you check PD membership?
Marco: checking... Jules isn't in the PD team yet, invite shows "pending" (sent 2026-03-29T14:00Z). re-sent invite and escalated for manual approval. also i'll ask SSO to ensure PD role mapping includes the "oncall-ack" permission.
Jules: thanks. about the runbook UI, it shows "Failed to parse: unexpected token at line 1" when opening https://runbooks.redwood.ai/eng/oncall/night-shift
ops-bot: Runbooks Service  Build 542 deployed. Note: markdown-to-json transform failed for /eng/oncall/night-shift (line 12).
Priyanka: ops-bot confirms build problem. Marco, is there a cached render we can roll back to?
Marco: yes, we can roll back to render v2026-03-20 if needed. i'll trigger rollback for the night-shift doc so the UI shows the stable copy.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty  Invitation resent to Jules (jules@redwood.ai) for schedule "eng-oncall". Invitation status: pending.
Jules: rollback helped, runbook loads now. thanks! PD still pending though.
Priyanka: while PD settles, here's a quick checklist for tonight: 1) ack incoming test alerts 2) check quota dashboard /dash/quotas 3) if DB errors, follow the db-hotfix section, and page db-oncall if severity >= sev2. i'll DM you the short cheat sheet.
Marco: PD invite approved by ops. Jules should appear on the schedule in ~2min. also gave Jules the PD role "Responder" so ack button should be enabled.
Jules: i see the schedule now and acked a test alert, confirm push and SMS both work. thanks for the fast turnaround.
Priyanka: great. want to run a 15m sim in 30m to practice an actual pager flow and using the runbook? we'll simulate a throttling incident.
Jules: yes please, 15m is perfect.
Marco: i'll join and walk through rollback procedure and how to check runbook render logs: `kubectl logs -n docs render-54 | grep night-shift`. also quick tip: if runbook JSON fails, fallback is the rendered HTML cache at /static/runbooks/night-shift.html.
Jules: noted. thanks everyone, feeling much better about the shift. :thumbsup:
